title: Beta.11 independent family evidence for fifteen selected credential families (#379)
description: Independently authored positives, non-twin benign controls and one-property twins for the fifteen families #377's frozen family/axis ledger selected (new-relic-license-key, mailchimp, deepgram, heroku-legacy, confluent-legacy, twilio-auth-token, anthropic admin01/api01, cohere, bedrock long-term, together, openai-admin, connection-string, stripe-token, github-token). Positives author the expected span and the redact action; ledger revisions are recorded in the generator. Values are synthetic, never provider-issued. Measures and records; moves no support status or profile floor.
